title: Moor grass and heather
subject: Subject: the ground of an open moor, about 3 m across, seen from above. Short olive and dusky green moor grass with many small soft patches of purple heather in bloom spread evenly through it, and a few tiny white flowers. Night, under a bright full moon: cool silver-lavender moonlight, plum-indigo shadows, but the texture itself evenly lit.
use: The ground of the Warm Roads moor fight.

title: Heather clump
subject: Subject: one low rounded clump of moor heather in bloom, about 50 cm across and 30 cm high: wiry dark stems, tiny dark green needle leaves, many small purple-pink flower spikes. Night colours.
use: Scattered round the Warm Roads moor fight.

title: Gorse bush
subject: Subject: one gorse bush, about 1.2 m across and 1 m high: a dense rounded mass of dark spiny green shoots covered in small golden-yellow flowers. Night colours with the yellow muted by moonlight.
use: Along the walls and round the edges of the Warm Roads moor fight.

title: Silver birch
subject: Subject: one slim silver birch tree, whole, about 12 m high: a thin white trunk with black marks, thin upward branches and a light open crown of small dark olive leaves. Silver moonlight on the white bark.
use: The birches round the Warm Roads moor fight, and its live framing tree.

title: Ember Line waymarker stone
subject: Subject: one tall old standing stone, seen flat from the front, about 2.5 m high: rough grey-lavender stone tapering to a blunt top, with a round carved sigil near the top holding a small disc of warm amber light, lichen and moss on it, set on a low base of two or three fitted stones.
use: The waymarker beside the Ember Line road at the Warm Roads moor fight.

title: Far round watchtower
subject: Subject: an old round stone watchtower, seen flat from the front, about 15 m high: grey stone courses, a crenellated top, two small warm lit windows, a low broken wall at its foot. Cold night colours apart from the windows.
use: A far backdrop piece on a crag beyond the Warm Roads moor.
